items.title: ‘Game of Thrones’ Movie ‘Aegon’s Conquest’ Sets Summer 2029 Release Date
items.summary: Winter is coming to the big screen… in summer of 2029. “Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest,” the first movie set in the fictional world of Westeros, has been scheduled for June 6, 2029.

items.title: The Strokes’ Nick Valensi Joins Jack White In LA
items.summary: Once upon a time, the Strokes and the White Stripes were the two biggest dogs in the early-'00s rock-revival moment. The White Stripes no longer exist, but Jack White continues to soldier on as a solo act.
